budget_items.topic: Rollstone Bank pledge and memorial donation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Rollstone Bank completed its 5-year pledge, and a $100 donation was received from Mrs. Norman Cross in memory of Mary Emily Smith-Peterson.
budget_items.quote: a donation of $100 was received from mrs. norman cross in memory of mary emily smith -

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Library expenditures from the Revolving Fund to date were reported.
budget_items.quote: library expenditures from revolving fund to date: $1,680.47.

budget_items.topic: C/W MARS rates and lender credit
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Next year's C/W MARS rates are expected to be 6.5% less than this year due to the switchover to Evergreen; the new formula is based on circulation and holdings rather than port fees, and net lender credit has been eliminated.
budget_items.quote: c/w mar's rates for next year are expected to be 6.5% less than this year due to the switchover to evergreen

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town manager notified the director that the FY budget adopted in May 2010 included a wage freeze for non-union employees, so the request for a yearly increase for SalAdmin staff will not go through. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: therefore, the request to provide saladmin staff a yearly increase will not go through.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Friends will pay for the service agreement for the new phone system. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: friends will pay for the service agreement for the new phone system.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lakeview aerated and reseeded the front lawn, paid for by the Friends. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: lakeview aerated and reseeded the front lawn (paid for by the friends)

budget_items.topic: Friends Book and Bake Sale revenue
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Book and Bake Sale attendance and revenue were down, though the bake sale brought in the most money. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: book and bake sale attendance and revenue were down; however, the bake sale brought in the most money!
